_comment: Game constants, merged over the defaults in game.py. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the merge, so notes can sit beside the values they describe.
name: KLAUDIUSZ

hunger._note: Tokens that must be spent per hour to keep the bar full, and how many idle hours empty it from full to starving.

happiness._note: Petting is always playable; only the reward is rate limited.

life._note: Settled at midnight: both daily goals met earns half a heart, missing either costs a whole one. Every unattended day is charged separately.

level._note: Levels cost 100 EXP and 35% more each time. Taps are the small change on top of tokens and petting, so they are capped per day and cleared at midnight. `titles` lines up with LEVEL_SPRITES in state.py.
